dialogue.speaker: Annette
dialogue.text: I just had too much fun. Shopping with you always reminds me of school in Fhirdiad.

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: It does feel like a story from long ago.

dialogue.speaker: Annette
dialogue.text: So much has changed since then.
